summary: Phase A PermitAI — 12/12 backend pytest PASS (photomontage Nano Banana via Emergent + batiments voisins IGN + me/subscription + stripe/portal + webhook stripe regression + cerfa notice/analyze-plan regression + 4 public pages). Frontend source code verified by static inspection: all required data-testid attributes present in /app/components/PhotomontagePCMI6.js, /app/app/dashboard/billing/page.js, /app/app/dashboard/page.js. Live UI testing of /dashboard/billing via Playwright not possible because Clerk middleware returns HTML 404 (not 302) for unauthenticated requests and the Emergent preview URL shows the 'Wake up servers' interstitial in automation.

minor.issue: Returns Clerk's HTML 404 instead of the documented JSON {authenticated:false, plan:'free', credits:1, limit} when unauthenticated. Acceptable per review_request (must just not 500), but a public fallback JSON would improve client UX and let the billing page render the free plan instead of a 404.
Unauthenticated POST returns Clerk HTML 404 (not the documented JSON 404 'Aucun abonnement actif'). Same root cause as above (Clerk middleware swallows the request before the route handler).

voisins_count=12 and plu.zone='Uj' as expected, but parcelle.geometry returned has coords around (4.146, 45.253) — that is NOT Lyon (45.7578, 4.832). Likely the IGN apicarto fetch is using a wrong bbox or first-result selection. parcelle.properties is also null. Functional contract still met (parcelle non-null, plu/regles populated) but the geometry is geographically incorrect for the requested lat/lon.

integration_issues.issue: Clerk middleware returns HTTP 404 (HTML) for /dashboard and /dashboard/billing when unauthenticated, instead of a 302 redirect to /sign-in. Source code review confirms all data-testid attributes (billing-page, current-plan, credits-counter, subscription-status, open-portal-btn, upgrade-btn, back-to-dashboard, change-plan-btn, billing-link) are present in JSX, but they cannot be reached via Playwright without a real Clerk session. Consider configuring clerkMiddleware to redirect protected routes to /sign-in for better UX + testability.

Component is conditionally rendered only when piece.source==='ia_claude' AND gen==='insertion_paysagere' AND step===5. Cannot validate via initial HTML scrape; requires walking the full 5-step wizard. Source code (components/PhotomontagePCMI6.js + app/cerfa/wizard/page.js line 1372) confirms data-testid='photomontage-pcmi6' and 'photomontage-upload-btn' are wired correctly.

action_items: (Optional UX) Customize clerkMiddleware to 302→/sign-in for /dashboard/** instead of returning 404 HTML — improves UX and unblocks Playwright testing.

(Optional) Make /api/me/subscription return the documented public JSON {authenticated:false, plan:'free', credits:1, limit} when unauthenticated instead of being middleware-gated, so the billing page can render a 'Free plan' state for anonymous visitors.

(Investigate) /api/batiments parcelle geometry: at (45.7578, 4.832) Lyon the returned parcelle geometry sits at (4.146, 45.253) — likely a wrong-bbox or wrong-first-feature pick from IGN apicarto. voisins/plu/regles are fine.
(Manual) Main agent should walk wizard 13406 to step 5 to visually confirm PhotomontagePCMI6 renders for the PCMI6 'insertion paysagère' piece and the generated JPEG is shown + downloadable.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/app/cerfa/wizard/page.js is still very large (>1370 lines) — recommend splitting per-step into subcomponents.
/app/lib/llm.js generateImage() correctly uses Emergent proxy with model 'gemini/gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview' and modalities=['image','text']; image returned in JPEG ~600KB confirmed via test.

/app/app/api/cerfa/photomontage/route.js — prompt is well-crafted (HMONP voice) and returns {success, image:{mime,base64}, provider, model}. Consider streaming or returning a temporary URL instead of inlined base64 to avoid 1MB+ JSON payloads.
/app/app/api/batiments/route.js — voisins fetch works (12 returned) but parcelle selection logic appears to pick a wrong feature for Lyon coords (see backend minor issue).
Both /api/me/subscription and /api/stripe/portal rely entirely on Clerk middleware for auth; without auth they return HTML 404 rather than a JSON error — inconsistent with the rest of the JSON API.

success_rate.frontend: static source verification only — Clerk-gated routes return 404 to unauthenticated automation and Emergent preview shows wake-up interstitial; cannot drive UI in this session

test_credentials: None — Clerk test session not available in automation environment.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_phase_a.py hit http://localhost:3000 directly (Next.js full-stack app). Photomontage takes ~30-60s per call (timeout=120s). /dashboard/billing is Clerk-gated → HTTP 404 for anonymous users (NOT 302); confirmed source-code presence of all required data-testids. To drive UI you need a real Clerk session OR a manual run via a logged-in browser. /api/batiments parcelle geometry mismatch at Lyon coords is a real bug to investigate even though the contract (voisins/plu/regles non-empty) passes.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bug. The two main quirks are: (1) Clerk middleware returns 404 instead of 302 for protected /dashboard/* routes (UX, not a functional bug), (2) /api/batiments returns a Lyon-incorrect parcelle geometry while still satisfying the structural contract (logical bug worth investigating but not blocking).
